t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The colour of the gnomes and mushrooms denotes a higher or lower value of points to be gained.

vb_textbox.text: If you choose a gnome that gives a lot of points, keep chossing that side of the two gnomes for as long as possible until that side of gnomes return 1 or two low numbers. Once it starts to return low numbers switch to the other side and the other gnome. Once that other side returns low numbers again make the switch agin to the other side.
